##### Project general facts

Alba Residence by Amaya Properties is an elegantly designed boutique building rising across a ground floor plus four levels, home to just twenty stylish apartments. The collection is made up of eight one-bedroom and twelve two-bedroom homes, including generous executive layouts, so there is a perfect fit for singles, couples and small families alike. Wrapped in clean stone-and-glass architecture with wide balconies and cascading greenery, it is an ideal choice for anyone seeking a convenient and vibrant living experience.

The building is designed around everyday ease, with two ground-floor retail units bringing shopping and services right to the doorstep. Residents benefit from covered, secure parking and round-the-clock security, so coming and going always feels safe and effortless. A welcoming entrance lobby, lift access to every floor and landscaped surroundings complete a thoughtfully planned home base that simply works.

Step inside and the apartments feel bright, calm and contemporary, with outstanding light-coloured finishes, warm wood-tone flooring and beautiful cove lighting that softens every ceiling. The sleek, modern kitchens elevate both functionality and style, combining glossy handleless cabinetry with a stone backsplash, integrated appliances and a breakfast counter that opens onto the living and dining area. Bedrooms are fitted with full-height built-in wardrobes and floor-to-ceiling curtains for a restful feel, while the bathrooms are finished in striking veined marble with fluted timber detailing, backlit mirrors and a walk-in rain shower.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Liwan, a dynamic and well-integrated residential community in the heart of Dubai, this exceptional location offers a harmonious blend of modern living, convenience, and tranquility. The community is characterized by thoughtfully planned infrastructure, spacious landscaped parks, and pedestrian-friendly pathways, promoting a sense of connectivity and community engagement.

The location is distinguished by its central positioning and easy access to major road networks, making commuting and exploring the city effortless. The presence of schools, mosques, retail centers, and recreational spaces within the community emphasizes its self-sustained nature, offering residents everything they need right at their doorstep.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern elegance, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Liwan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of tranquil parks, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — serene, connected and effortlessly refined.
